problem: mark_recomputed previously rewrote every same-user invalidation up to through_id, including completed historical receipts, replacing their analysis_version and causing unnecessary historical writes

changes.index_sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_invalidation_pending ON training_invalidation(user_id,id) WHERE status='pending'
index_support: pending_invalidations same-user pending rows ordered by id
mark_recomputed pending prefix through the inclusive id boundary
changes.migration: Additive CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS within the existing migration savepoint; no existing invalidation data is changed
changes.transaction: Existing mark_recomputed savepoint remains nested in its caller's transaction

verified_behaviors: An old recomputed row retains all original fields and its prior analysis_version
Only the same user's pending row through the inclusive id boundary is completed
Another user's pending row is unchanged even when its id is within the boundary
A later pending row remains pending
A repeated completion with a different version performs zero writes and preserves prior receipts
The pending read and completion UPDATE both use the partial index
Index upgrade and rerun preserve invalidation row contents
An outer transaction rollback restores all invalidation rows

fixture_setup_attempt.interpretation: Four fixture setup errors, not product-regression failures: create_equipment does not enqueue an analysis invalidation, so the first fixture incorrectly indexed an empty pending list. The fixture was changed to real start_session calls before the valid failing-before run.

failing_before.interpretation: Three genuine failures and one pass with the corrected real-service fixture: completed history was overwritten, repeating completion rewrote receipts, and no pending-only query index existed. Outer transaction rollback already passed.

passing_after.interpretation: All four directed tests passed after restricting completion to pending rows and adding the partial index. This is not a repository-wide regression result.

sanitization: Hostname, host and pid attributes removed
Properties and captured environment stdout/stderr removed from public XML
Test identities, assertions, true result counts and timings retained
Unmodified raw XML, terminal logs and source receipts retained locally and bound by SHA256
verification_limits: Four directed tests and Ruff passed; final integrated verification belongs to the coordinator's fresh full run
The fixture setup errors, failing-before result and passing-after result are distinct runs and are not combined into an inflated passing total
No million-row latency result is claimed here; the benchmark task must measure the final frozen source and include the pending index in cold-upgrade simulation
